title: VoiceUtterance
description: Response of POST /v1/voice/utterance (multipart: `audio` = audio/webm;codecs=opus | audio/wav | audio/ogg, max 15 s and 1 MB; optional `lang_hint` = ar|en; optional `follow_up` = 1). The audio is transcribed on our own machine and discarded; neither audio nor transcript is stored or logged. Wake phrase and intent are decided by fixed rules; when no rule matches, the transcript is also compared by a LOCAL embedding model (qwen3-embedding, on this machine, no text generated) with the FAQ questions, and goes nowhere else. Scope: read.

wake.description: true when the utterance opens with a wake phrase (English: hey/hi/ok falcon, falcon lens; Arabic: يا صقر, عدسة الصقر, ...), tolerant of ASR spelling errors. Also true for the utterance sent with `follow_up=1` right after a bare wake phrase.

intent.description: Read from `command`. Without the wake phrase only a short bare stop word yields `stop`; every other utterance is `none`. `faq` = a scam-safety question that has a pre-recorded answer (`answer_id`); `off_topic` = anything else said after the wake phrase, including attempts to override the assistant's instructions (answered with a fixed polite redirect). No text is generated.

command.description: The part after the wake phrase, empty when there is no wake phrase.

answer_id.description: Name of the pre-written, pre-recorded answer clip (voice_faq.yaml: `<lang>.faq.<name>`) when `intent` is `faq`; otherwise null.

model.description: Engine and model that answered, e.g. `native:whisper-large-v3-turbo` or `container:faster-whisper-small`.
